serviceName: Send email from your own address
description: Lets Labbaik send your organisation's emails to families from an address on your own domain. Adds a DKIM key and the SPF and bounce records for the send and rsend subdomains. Your website and mailboxes are not changed.
variableDescription: dkim: the DKIM public key (base64, without the p= prefix) given by Labbaik's email provider (Resend) for this domain
